messages.author: d0b18666fe8582cb
messages.subject: weird output for DRF stat
parts:
Hi Phil, wondering if you have any thoughts at to what might be going on if I ran the DRF stat to assess DTF and the confidence intervals do not include the sDRF/uDRF stat...? My code and output are below. Any thoughts are appreciated. Thanks!

Keri

model.unconstrained <- multipleGroup(data = df[,c("x1", "x2", "x3", "x4","x5")], 1,
itemtype = c("graded"), group = as.character(df[,8]),
invariance = c("x4", "x1", "x5", 'free_means', 'free_var'),
SE.type = "Oakes", SE = TRUE)

dtf <- DRF(model.unconstrained, draws = 1000, DIF=FALSE, plot=FALSE, theta_lim = c(-3,3.05))

>   print(dtf)
     n_focal_items      stat    CI_2.5   CI_97.5       X2 df            p
sDRF             5 0.4736989 0.4942136 0.7993268 36.48940  1 1.534987e-09
uDRF             5 0.5028274 0.5148862 0.8070627 43.87664  2 2.966939e-10
